task_description: Turn the daily Insurgency Report into a rolling 30-day accumulation (replacing the 90-day window): each run, local CLI and Step Functions, starts from the published snapshot, dedupes by URL so known articles skip the agent, expires strikes older than 30 days, renumbers ids, and publishes; zero articles publishes the accumulated set; >20% discarded publishes the cleaned accumulated set without the day's new strikes. Plus: dedicated Lambda build folder, CloudFront scoped to site + snapshots/*, logging of filtered titles, docs/steering/specs updates, and recreating report-ingestion-news.md under docs/.
